survey_design.weight_fields_interpretation: This country note summarizes OECD Education at a Glance 2025 indicators using multiple underlying OECD/ILSA-style data sources (e.g., Survey of Adult Skills/PIAAC for literacy and adult outcomes). The note itself does not provide microdata sampling details or specify any student-level sampling/replicate weight variables, so weight application cannot be verified from the text. For users working with the underlying datasets, analysts should apply the official complex survey weights and replicate weights provided by the data producers when estimating population-representative statistics and uncertainty. The note reports indicator values and cross-country comparisons, but it does not document whether any weighting was applied at the country-note compilation stage.

It therefore uses the latest available indicator data for Poland as reported in the referenced Education at a Glance 2025 tables, with readers directed to the corresponding tables and methodology/technical notes for indicator construction and any underlying data processing.

data.outcome_summary: This OECD Education at a Glance 2025 country note for Poland summarizes system-level indicators rather than estimating an ML model on student microdata. It reports cross-generational educational inequality in tertiary attainment (e.g., large gaps by parents’ education), trends in unemployment by educational attainment, and employment/wage differences by degree level. For adult skills, it uses the OECD Survey of Adult Skills (PIAAC) to describe literacy proficiency distributions (e.g., share at or below Level 1) and average score gaps between attainment groups, including changes between PIAAC Cycle 1 (2012–15) and Cycle 2 (2023). The note also covers access and progression indicators in tertiary education (entry routes, gender composition, completion rates by timeframe and field), and system resource indicators (public expenditure per student, teacher shortages/turnover, and instructional time). Methodological details for each indicator are deferred to the Education at a Glance 2025 tables and the separate Sources, Methodologies and Technical Notes.

The extraction therefore leaves ML- and sample-specific fields null and points to the referenced OECD tables and methodology/technical notes for the underlying estimation procedures.
